description: This file contains onboarding and configuration logic for the Matrix channel in the OpenClaw project, including account setup, policy management, and interactive configuration prompts.

classes.name: ChannelSetupWizardAdapter
classes.description: Interface for channel setup wizard adapters, providing methods for status checking, configuration, and post-configuration actions.

methods.name: resolveMatrixOnboardingAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the onboarding account ID, defaulting to a normalized account ID based on configuration or default.

methods.name: setMatrixDmPolicy
methods.description: Sets the direct message policy for a given Matrix account configuration.

methods.name: noteMatrixAuthHelp
methods.description: Displays help information about Matrix authentication setup to the user.

methods.name: requiresMatrixPrivateNetworkOptIn
methods.description: Determines if private network access is required based on the homeserver URL.

methods.name: promptMatrixAllowFrom
methods.description: Prompts the user to specify allowed Matrix users or groups for direct messaging.

methods.name: setMatrixGroupPolicy
methods.description: Sets the group policy (open, allowlist, disabled) for a Matrix account.

methods.name: setMatrixGroupRooms
methods.description: Configures specific rooms for a Matrix account based on provided room keys.

methods.name: runMatrixConfigure
methods.description: Handles the interactive process of configuring a Matrix account, including homeserver URL, credentials, and room access.
